root_cause.text: The default futex hash allocation check in `need_futex_hash_allocate_default()` incorrectly required both `CLONE_THREAD` and `CLONE_VM`, failing to allocate the hash for mm-sharing clones without `CLONE_THREAD`, which caused a use-after-free when `mm->futex_ref` percpu counter was accessed after the mm had been repurposed.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "Currently need_futex_hash_allocate_default() depends on strict pthread semantics, abusing CLONE_THREAD. This breaks the non-concurrency assumptions when doing the mm->futex_ref pcpu allocations, leading to bugs... where the +1 bias can end up on a percpu counter that mm->futex_ref no longer points at." The patch changes the condition from `(clone_flags & (CLONE_THREAD | CLONE_VM)) == (CLONE_THREAD | CLONE_VM)` to `(clone_flags & (CLONE_VM | CLONE_VFORK)) == CLONE_VM`, loosening the check to cover any `CLONE_VM` clone except vfork.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix futex hash allocation for forked children: allocate default futex hash for any process sharing VM except vfork, rather than requiring both CLONE_THREAD and CLONE_VM.
intent_record.what: Changed the condition in `need_futex_hash_allocate_default` from checking for both `CLONE_THREAD` and `CLONE_VM` to checking that `CLONE_VM` is set and `CLONE_VFORK` is not set, and added a comment explaining the intent.
intent_record.how: The function now returns true for any clone that sets `CLONE_VM` without `CLONE_VFORK` (e.g., `fork()` and thread creation), whereas previously it returned true only when both `CLONE_THREAD` and `CLONE_VM` were set (i.e., only for thread creation). This changes allocation behavior: fork now gets a futex hash; vfork does not.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove redundant comment about allocating default futex hash for the first thread spawn.
intent_record.what: Removed a comment block (three lines) preceding the conditional call to futex_hash_allocate_default() that described the purpose of allocating a default futex hash when the first thread spawns.
intent_record.how: No functional change; the removal of the comment does not alter runtime behavior. The code logic remains identical.

candidates.rationale: This condition incorrectly requires both CLONE_THREAD and CLONE_VM to allocate the default futex hash, failing to allocate when only CLONE_VM is set (e.g., mm-sharing clones without CLONE_THREAD). This leads to a use-after-free when futex_ref is accessed after mm is repurposed.

vuln_statements.explanation: This condition incorrectly requires both CLONE_THREAD and CLONE_VM flags to be set to allocate the default futex hash. Clones that share memory (CLONE_VM) but not CLONE_THREAD (e.g., pthread_create with CLONE_VM only) will fail the check, leading to a missing hash allocation. Consequently, futex_ref percpu counter is accessed after the mm has been repurposed, causing a use-after-free.
